notes.title: 小型更新
notes.notes: 降低了难度，但是没有降低游戏的乐趣。

notes.title: 重要更新
notes.notes: 给沙丁鱼和其他动物加上了血条，给玩家更多机会的同时，也给其他动物更多机会，游戏的趣味性大大增加，同时难度也跟着增加，希望你们能喜欢！

notes.title: Important update
notes.notes: The game has more exciting levels, sardines will be attacked by a variety of animals, you need to operate sardines to avoid the attack of these Marine animals, and find the opportunity to beat them, players who have finished the game can click to continue the game, new levels will be displayed in front of you, you can continue until you pass the last level, the game also adds background music, Makes it feel better for you to play.
